show.sharing_text: हेलो! मैंने कुकू एफएम पर इस शो को सुना और मेरे ख्‍याल से आपको भी पसंद आएगा
show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/kMBYnt
show.description: On a stormy night, wounded gangster Ranveer forces nurse Anika into a marriage at gunpoint and gives her 30 days to fall in love with him—or walk free. Trapped in his dangerous world, Anika plans to expose him, but slowly discovers his softer side. As her hatred turns into love and she learns she’s pregnant, Ranveer’s past returns, forcing her to leave. When truth finally comes out, love defeats fear—and they reunite.
